protocol.experiment: 10 (V14): does the SOURCE of the cross-block neighbours buy anything? Same window, same budget, same training as V13; only the rule that picks the 4 neighbours changes -- kind-blind top-k versus 2 of the query's own core/graft kind + 2 from the other side.
protocol.treatment: every slot is calibrated against a sparse set of OTHER blocks' slots: V13 takes the k = 4 most associated by reader-key cosine; V14 takes k_same = 2 of the query's own kind and k_cross = 2 from the other side of the core/graft divide, softmaxed per group with equal group mass. The context vector is injected into the residual bottleneck by a zero-initialised projection; the slot itself is never blended, and the same bounded low-rank map moves it, with a tighter ceiling on carrier slots (0.15 x rms) than on graft slots (0.50 x rms)

relation.treatment: five INDEPENDENT top-4 relations, one per utility layer (12/16/20/24/28), each softmaxed with a per-layer sink logit that is dropped afterwards so the retained mass can be below 1; the feature is the neighbours minus the slot (sum_j w_ij v_j - m_i v_i); it enters as a FiLM modulation, b * (1 + tanh(W_s c)) + tanh(W_h c), on an RMS-normalised sum of five per-layer projections; memory layers 0..9 keep the self branch only

permutation.treatment: inference time only, no retraining: V13's precomputed cross-block context rows are shuffled inside (source_block, slot_type) groups, so each slot draws from the same batch of neighbours it could draw from before and only the slot -> row pairing changes
permutation.not_done: random top-4 neighbours, which would change the marginal distribution of the context as well as the pairing

donor.definition: the plain calibration's window with the 684 graft slots taken from the previous row's document

cross_donor.definition: V13's window with the 684 graft slots taken from the previous row's document: the only thing that changes is whose content the calibrator is conditioned on

complement.definition: V13's window calibrated by the complement-mode module: identical slots, identical graft content, only the neighbour source differs

complement_donor.definition: V14 on the donor window: the complement arm's own content-causality control

evict.definition: same selection and calibration, carriers cut to 1,620 by plain eviction instead of folding

unchanged_conditions.carriers: the same 9, selected once and shared by every arm
unchanged_conditions.window: the same 19-block write, document prefix only
unchanged_conditions.transport: one selection shared by all 32 layers; chronological output

checks.reproduction: Full, Selection, Graft and AnchorOnly must reproduce the reference report row for row
checks.capacity: every V11 arm holds 2,304 slots split 1,620 / 684
checks.provenance: every graft slot from a dropped block, verbatim; every core slot from a carrier
checks.folding: unfolded slots are verbatim copies; folded slots keep their representative's per-layer RMS
checks.calibration: both halves must move, and the RMS restore must hold
checks.cross_block: the context must be built from other blocks: the neighbour block spread is recorded per row
checks.donor: the donor arm's window must differ from the true one
checks.neighbour_source: --v14 must be complement mode and --v11-evict top-k mode with the same k, so the two arms differ in the neighbour source alone; V14's calibrated window must differ from V13's
checks.permutation: the permuted arms must change the cross-block context (a permutation that moves nothing is refused), must differ from V13 in answers or the arm is refused, and must still hold the 2,304-slot budget; the self-calibration branch and every weight stay untouched

protocol.screening_caveat: the rescue/protection groups are selected using the answer and the evidence location, so their accuracies are a mechanism diagnostic and must never be reported as a dataset score; the full-split columns are the honest reference
protocol.scoring: official HotpotQA QA F1, F1 >= threshold is correct
